text: Hm. Hard to tell from this alone.
It looks like a map, but it's only a scrap.
A map? I can't make it out.
Hm. One scrap tells me little.
Could be a map. I need more of it.
Very well. I'll take it, then.
Looks like a map. I'd need another piece.
Fair point. I'll gladly take it.
Looks like a map, but one piece tells me little.
Are you sure I can have it?
All right, I'll take it. Thank you.
Excuse me. Are you a sailor?
Could be a map to long-lost sunken treasure.
No luck, then? Here, you can have it.
If a sailor can't read it, what use is it to me?
Yes. Have you seen anything like it?
Yes. Know anything about maps like this?
Yes! I'll collect all the pieces!
Tell me if you hear anything!
Yes, I'm trying to find out more. Know anything?
It's just a scrap. Know anything of it?
Just a scrap, yes. Heard any rumors?
That thing you're holding, is it a map?
Here. It came with the cargo. No one claimed it.

They tell of a treasure ship
sunk in ages past.
I am sure of the place,
and mark it here.

My fleet reached the place,
but we had to turn back.

A lost continent vanished
like a dream at dawn.
A relic proves it was real.

Here I mark where to find
a blade still without equal.

An exiled royal house
lost its ship and fortune.
Both lie under the sand.

You who take this in hand,
carry on my work. Free it
from the dark where
no light can reach.

Legend says treasures lie
in those accursed waters.
Many have been tempted,
and I am one of them.

Many ships sailed out.
Not one returned.
My fleet perished at sea,
and my hopes went with it.

Death set its sights
on that accursed city.
The earth rose in fury,
and the city sank in grief.

An emblem of prosperity
lies in a sea of sorrow.
Death came all the same
for those who lent a hand.

A pirate once known
throughout the world.
Ages passed. His glory
and his trail both faded.

His treasure sleeps
with his departed soul.
I found where it lies,
but died on the way.

In calm or storm,
let the sea
carry your dreams.

Take up my cause.
May this map bring luck
to all who seek.

Let down your guard and
its cavernous jaws
will swallow you whole.

Keep that thing away.
No creature of this world
could look like that.

It coils a thousand arms
around you and drags you
into the dark. A devil.

The demon rests in hell.
A hero will strike it down
with a sword.

It lurks beneath the sea,
splits waves and strikes
terror. The unwary fall
to its fangs.

Water bars every path.
A steady hand at the helm
opens the way ahead.

The furious waves tear
even stout ships apart.
A forest of masts remains.

Let a thousand battles
fuel the fire that burns
it to ash. Then the sea
will bless you.
